Milvus 2.5.8 is retained visibly but is not timed on this unchanged corpus.
Milvus BM25 requires raw text in a VARCHAR input field with a 65,535-byte maximum.
Twenty documents in the 250k corpus exceed that limit; the maximum is 202,798 bytes.
Truncating only Milvus would change the benchmark workload, so every query class is marked unsupported.
